response.sql: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) as avg_pt, AVG(CASE WHEN l.IGA IS NOT NULL AND l.IGM IS NOT NULL THEN l.IGA - l.IGM END) as avg_iga_igm_diff FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) as overall_mean FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.IGA IS NOT NULL AND l.IGM IS NOT NULL), patient_ratios AS (SELECT ps.ID, ps.SEX, ps.avg_pt, ps.avg_iga_igm_diff, ps.avg_iga_igm_diff / om.overall_mean as ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_stats ps CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE ps.avg_iga_igm_diff IS NOT NULL AND om.overall_mean IS NOT NULL) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) as avg_pt, AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) as avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(ratio_to_overall_mean) as avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_ratios GROUP BY SEX ORDER BY SEX
